description: Totals for any mix of foods, products, recipes and supplements in any amounts (up to 200 items, at most 50 of them text; a text item costs what resolve charges for one phrase), and each item's own values: every line in items has nutrients for the same fields, in the total's unit, so a meal or food log shows and edits each entry without subtracting. Missing values are never counted as zero: an item with no value for a nutrient leaves it out of its nutrients, and every total has coverage (share of items with a known value) and lists which items lacked it. A text line says how it was matched, as resolve does: confidence, assumed ("item": other close matches exist, listed in alternatives; "portion"; "preparation"), the portion it was weighed by, and dropped or corrected words. A text that matched nothing is in unresolved with the reason and the closest items. Check assumed before you answer: "30 g whey" is fluid whey unless you choose the dried one. Every requested field is in totals: a key no item has a value for is value null with the reason, never dropped. Each line carries cite and the item url.

fields.description: Only return these nutrient keys (e.g. ["energy","protein"]). Saves tokens. A group name returns every key under it, each as its own value in its own unit, never added or converted: "vitamin_a" gives vitamin_a.rae (µg) and vitamin_a.iu (IU); "carbohydrate" gives carbohydrate.total (includes fibre), carbohydrate.available (excludes it) and carbohydrate.available_mse. A key that is itself a registry key (e.g. "fat") is just that key. A name that matches nothing comes back missing with the closest keys.

anyOf.description: A phrase, as resolve takes it: "2 large eggs".

id.description: Entity id, e.g. fd_k3m9x2q8vt7w4p (food), pr_ (product), sp_ (supplement), mi_ (menu item), rc_ (recipe). A source id also works: fdc:<USDA fdcId>, ndb:<NDB number>, dsld:<DSLD id>, fndds:<food code>, lnhpd:<LNHPD id>, ciqual:<alim_code>, cnf:<food code>, cofid:<food code>, matvaretabellen:<food id>, slv:<Livsmedelsverket number>.

text.description: Free text instead of an id, e.g. "2 large eggs scrambled". Resolved first.

unit.description: g, oz, ml, cup, tbsp, serving, slice, capsule... Defaults to "serving" for products and supplements, "g" with quantity 100 otherwise.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale, e.g. en-US, en-GB, ja-JP. Decides household measure sizes (a US cup is 236.6 ml, a metric cup 250 ml).

regime.description: With fields: add values derivable for this regime to every item and the totals (e.g. EU adds salt from sodium), each marked derived_from. Without it, a requested field only sodium can give is null with a reason saying so.

name: nutrition
